notes.title: May 11th Patch Note
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Improved control reaction speed.
    - Character stops more quickly when you release the stick.
    - The character always moves at full speed regardless of the stick tilt.
[*]We've made a new default key setting. But for those who have their own, customized key setting, you must restore the key setting back to default to try the new one.
    To restore to default key setting, look for the "reset to default" button in key binding preferences.
[*]Nerfed Quarterstaff.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed the door that wouldn't open even after wiping out all the enemies on floor 2.
[*]Fixed the quarterstaff evading animation that was moving characters in the wrong direction.
[*]Fixed how dodging while walking moved the character further.[/list]

notes.title: May 8th Patch Note
notes.notes:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list][*]Key Rebinding : You can change keys in the game at any time in Preferences.[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Attacks using Quarterstaff is now faster.
- The quicker you hit the Combo attack button, the faster the attack.
- You can move during finishing a Combo attack motion.
- Combo Attack 1 and 2 are weaker, and 3 are slightly stronger.
- Pre-attack delay of Charge attack is reduced, but charging time is increased.
[*]The movement speed of the player character is increased by 12.5%.
[*]There are more skeletons on the first floor. Instead, the skeleton's health decreased by 33%.
[*]On the second floor, the number of goblins spawned per Igloo is limited.
 - Bomb goblins are spawned up to 2.
 - Snitch goblins are spawned up to 1.
[*]Bomb Goblins throw less bombs after the first bomb. Instead, the bomb deals 33% more damage.
[*]On the third floor, Lizardmen's health decreased. Instead, there is more lizard man warriors. (the green ones)
[*]The Gold flash before it disappears.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]
[*]Some monsters no longer break through walls.[/list]

[i]I will write it briefly next time.[/i]ːdddunamusedː
